variants.maintainer_notes: New variant: the RAM variant's command with --write-flash. openFPGALoader loads its SPI-over-JTAG bridge for the FPGA part (xc7a35tftg256, in oss-cad-suite's share/openFPGALoader), then writes the board's SPI flash. Not tried on hardware. Device selection (2026-11-04): --busdev-num ${BUS}:${DEV} added so openFPGALoader opens the device the engine chose, not the first one with these USB IDs. Low risk, so tested is unchanged: openFPGALoader's FTDI drivers (MPSSE, bitbang, CH552) open the device by bus and address when given (src/ftdipp_mpsse.cpp, ftdi_usb_open_bus_addr); not tried on hardware. USB filter (2026-11-05): the exact product name, from Alchitry's own loader, alchitry/Alchitry-Interface src/main/kotlin/com/alchitry/hardware/Board.kt (1c71e16), which finds boards by comparing it for equality: "Alchitry Au", "Alchitry Au+", "Alchitry Cu", and "Alchitry Au V2", "Alchitry Cu V2", "Alchitry Pt V2" for other boards, so the pattern matches the whole name.
